beats.vo: Seeing her this weekend and worried she'll realize you're inexperienced? You can just tell her.
beats.visual_intent: Apartment front door from inside, warm hallway light, no people.

beats.vo: You don't owe anyone your history. It's your call. But hiding it means spending the whole night acting like you know what you're doing, and that's the most stressful way to do this.
beats.visual_intent: Spotlight on an empty stage, dark theater.

beats.vo: One honest line takes the pressure off: "I don't have a lot of experience, but I really care about making this good for you."

visual.text: I really care about making this good for you.

beats.vo: Say it before things start, not in the middle. Keep it short. No apology, no backstory.
beats.visual_intent: Hallway in evening light, soft shadows, no people.

beats.vo: It tells her you're paying attention to her, not putting on a show. And it means you get to ask questions instead of guessing.
beats.visual_intent: City street at dusk, warm shop lights, no identifiable people.
